description: The A2 usage ledger: every metered billing event newest-first with attribution — featureId, amount, the project/job that produced it, and the event's LIST price in USD (a plan allowance may zero it on the invoice). Answer "what did project X cost this period?" with a query instead of summing your own quotes. Filter by projectId, jobId, and/or a [from, to) epoch-ms window. Requires the billing:read scope.

after.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `pagination.nextCursor`. Forward-only.

jobId.description: Only events produced by this job — how to answer "did my failed render post a charge?" for one run.

limit.description: Page size (1..100), default 20. Out-of-range or unparseable clamps into the range.

projectId.description: Only events attributed to this project.

name: get_usage
title: Get Usage
